notes: The *and* before *to sacrifice* is `added`: the Hebrew writes `לְהַעֲלוֹת עֹלוֹת לִזְבֹּחַ` asyndetically, so no morpheme licenses the coordinator (rule 14's closing sentences).
`שְׁלָמִים` → *of peace offerings* heads on *peace*: the ASV never writes *offerings* alone for the word, so the noun is the supplied generic (rule 31).
